How these medicines Work
Mounjaro and Wegovy injections reduce weight by:
Slowing down digestion of food or pass-through from your stomach which reduces your appetite to help you eat smaller portions
Increases insulin which maintains steady blood glucose, reducing the likelihood of sugar spikes leading to craving and reaching out to sugary treats
Makes you feel less hungry by working on the brain receptors making you feel less hungry and more satisfied after eating a meal

One injection a week will enable you to reach your weight loss targets and improve your mental health. We will demonstrate on site how to use the injection pen. We will show you where to inject and provide all the additional items required, like sharps bins, swabs and pen needles all free of charge. We will also provide leaflets advising you on exercise regimes, healthy eating habits, information on the products supplied and a leaflet showing you how to use your injection.

We will also call you weekly during the first month to check you are happy with the product, advise you on any side effects, any local irritation at the injection site and more general information about using the product.

FAQs
What are the side effects of Mounjaro and Wegovy?
They are both in the same therapeutic group so have similar side effect profiles. If you decide to transfer from Mounjaro to Wegovy then you should experience similar side effects if any.

The most common side effects include vomiting, feeling sick, diarrhoea, constipation and indigestion. There can also be irritation at the injection site. These products can also cause dizziness, tiredness and headaches. These symptoms usually don’t last long and can be linked to dehydration or reduced calorie intake due to the effectiveness of the injections. Our pharmacists are available for a more detailed discussion on side effects.
Is it true Mounjaro can cause hair loss?

Although it has been reported that Mounjaro can cause hair loss it is more likely this hair loss is caused not by the drug itself but instead by the lifestyle changes caused as a result of using the medication. Our pharmacists will discuss ways that hair loss can be prevented.
Can I change from Mounjaro to Wegovy?

Wegovy is a more cost effective GLP-1 treatment. However, research has reported that patients achieve their weight loss target earlier with Mounjaro. Our pharmacists will advise you on the best treatment for each client. The washout period is one week. Wegovy has other benefits apart from weight loss including a healthier heart, can be used in conjunction with oral contraceptives and fewer side effects at the site of injection. Mounjaro is a GIP/GLP-1 agonist whereas Wegovy is just a GLP-1 agonist. This means Mounjaro has a reduced effect on the GI thus less nausea and vomiting. This means Mounjaro is better tolerated at higher dosages.

Body mass index is a value derived from the mass and height of a person. The BMI is defined as the body mass divided by the square of the body height, and is expressed in units of kg/m², resulting from mass in kilograms and height in metres (m). We can initiate supply of weight loss medication if the client has a BMI of 30 or over. If there are other medical conditions then this will be reduced to 27.
What is an achievable weight loss?

Our experience is that clients lose between 3 and 5 kilos per month. We will discuss with clients whether to increase the dose each month but our pharmacists are inclined to maintain the same dose each month whilst satisfactory weight loss is being achieved. There is no maximum duration for treatment, and no official lower BMI threshold at which treatment should be ceased. In fact, studies show that patients who stop treatment often experience weight regain within a few months, so continued use is usually recommended, even after achieving target weight.

If BMI falls below 22.5 then our pharmacists will discuss a reduction in dose to the lowest effective dose. If BMI falls below 20 then treatment will be discontinued to protect the patients’ health and well-being.
What is the process when using the injection pen?

Our pharmacists will demonstrate the injection technique to all patients. A dummy pen is available to aid the demonstration although all injections are carried out at home or workplace. Any localized side effects will be discussed at the first consultation. Free alcoholic wipes, spare needles and a sharps bin will be provided free of charge.
What post supply support will I receive from Moston Pharmacy?

Our pharmacists will take you through the whole process at the initial consultation. There will be weekly telephone support during the first month to monitor side effects and answer any questions. The pharmacist are available via a visit or telephone for any additional information.
Do I need to sign up to a subscription?
There is no need to sign up to a subscription at Moston Pharmacy.
Why do my friends increase the dose of Mounjaro each month?

There is no need to increase the dose each month. Our pharmacist will discuss dose maintenance or dose increase during each monthly visit. If it is decided that the weight lost during a month is acceptable then there is no need to increase the dose.
Xenical and Orlistat treatment
Xenical and Orlistat have the same active ingredient. They are available as a capsule and work by reducing the absorption of dietary fat from the gastrointestinal tract.
Orlistat works as a reversible inhibitor of gut lipases, which are responsible for breaking down ingested fats. This leads to a one third reduction in fat absorption into the body.
Side effects of Orlistat include flatulence, fatty stools and increased bowel movements.

These products should be used with lifestyle changes such as increased exercise, a balanced diet and reduced fat intake. Our pharmacists are available on site for advice, product selection guidance and general professional help.
